title: Approximation Classes for Adaptive Finite Elements
statement: For the two-dimensional Poisson equation with linear finite elements, suppose $0<s\leq\frac12$ and the solution $u$ belongs to the approximation class $\mathcal{A}^s$, meaning that its best energy-norm error on suitable $n$-element partitions is $O(n^{-s})$. Must the right-hand side $f$ admit piecewise-constant approximations on $n$-element partitions whose error in the dual norm is also $O(n^{-s})$?
